basis_free_dual: The full original T2 statement is equivalent by Ky Fan/Schatten duality and optimization over traceless A,B to ||Tr_A R||F²+||Tr_B R||F²−|Tr R|²/2≤2||R||F² for every rank≤2 operator R on C4⊗C4. This retains full complex quantifiers and is a reformulation, not a proof.
swap_reduction: For rank-two SVD R=s1|u1⟩⟨v1|+s2|u2⟩⟨v2|, with each u-frame and v-frame orthonormal, define local swaps F_A,F_B on two copies, antisymmetrizers Aminus=(I−F_A)/2, Bminus=(I−F_B)/2, and T=Aminus+Bminus+2Aminus Bminus⪰0. The diagonal rank-one terms satisfy q_i=3/2−t_ii with t_ii=⟨u_i⊗v_i,T(u_i⊗v_i)⟩. The mixed term is q12=−⟨u1⊗v2,T(u2⊗v1)⟩: the 3I/2 part vanishes because the u- and v-frames are separately orthogonal.
exact_scalar_unpaid: Full T2 is equivalent to |⟨u1⊗v2,T(u2⊗v1)⟩|²≤(1/2+t_11)(1/2+t_22) for every pair of orthonormal u- and v-frames. Arbitrary phases/weights are captured by singular-vector phase freedom and the associated 2×2 Hermitian quadratic form. The PSD Cauchy estimate |mixed|²≤t_12 t_21 alone does NOT imply this inequality in general without an additional cross-frame argument.
